lead_raw_text:
The structure of Yb2Ge2Bi2 (YbGeBi) is cubic with space group Fm-3m (No. 225) and 24 atoms in the unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Bi and Ge center has eight Yb neighbors, and each Yb center has four Bi plus four Ge neighbors, all at 3.1897 Å in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face sharing between Bi and Ge 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between like Bi–Bi and Ge–Ge polyhedra.
